open Scheme Grassmannian

  Scheme.functionFieldOverModule

section HighWindowRelations

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
  [hSmoothC : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [hProperC : IsProper C.hom]
  [hGeometricallyIrreducibleC : GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi] [IsDominant pi]

noncomputable local instance instOverCleftHighWindowRelations :
    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
variable (g r1 r2 : Nat)
variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k ((windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    + (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)) ⊤))
variable (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)

local notation "RZ" => DivCarveChartRing k
  (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
  (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j
local notation "HS" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
  (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)

/-! ## The arbitrary successor multiplication map -/

/-- Reindex the product divisor `sF + (M + n*s)F` as the next high window. -/
noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowSuccEquiv (n : Nat) :
    ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
        ((windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) +
          (divUniversalHighWindowExponent (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n •
            fiberWeilDivisor pi)) ⊤) ≃ₗ[k]
      divUniversalHighWindowSections (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g (n + 1) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (congrArg (fun D => Scheme.divisorSections k D ⊤) (by
    rw [← add_nsmul]
    apply congrArg (fun m : Nat => m • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    simp only [divUniversalHighWindowExponent, Nat.succ_mul]
    omega))

/-- Multiplication by one multiplier-basis section from high window `n` to `n+1`. -/
noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (n : Nat) (a : HS) :
    divUniversalHighWindowSections (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n →ₗ[k]
      divUniversalHighWindowSections (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g (n + 1) :=
  (divUniversalHighWindowSuccEquiv (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n).toLinearMap.comp
    (sectionMulBilin k
      (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
      (divUniversalHighWindowExponent (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n •
        fiberWeilDivisor pi) a)

/-- The finite tuple source used to span the successor of a relation module `K`. -/
noncomputable abbrev DivUniversalHighWindowMulSource (n : Nat)
    (K : Submodule RZ
      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n)) :
    Type u :=
  Fin (Module.finrank k HS) → ↥K

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
-- Elaborating the nested base change and dependent high-window ambient exceeds the default budget.
/-- The finite basis-indexed multiplication map carrying `K_n` into window `n+1`. -/
noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowMulMap (n : Nat)
    (K : Submodule RZ
      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n)) :
    DivUniversalHighWindowMulSource (C := C) (pi := pi)
        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K →ₗ[RZ]
      divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1) :=
  ∑ t : Fin (Module.finrank k HS),
    (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
      (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n
        ((Module.finBasis k HS) t))).comp
      (K.subtype.comp (LinearMap.proj t))

/-- The successor relation module: the finite `RZ`-linear multiplication span of `K`. -/
noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (n : Nat)
    (K : Submodule RZ
      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n)) :
    Submodule RZ
      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1)) :=
  LinearMap.range
    (divUniversalHighWindowMulMap (C := C) (pi := pi)
      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K)

set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
-- Finiteness inference unfolds the dependent finite tuple source.
/-- A successor multiplication source is finite when its input relation module is finite. -/
theorem finite_divUniversalHighWindowMulSource (n : Nat)
    (K : Submodule RZ
      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
    [Module.Finite RZ ↥K] :
    Module.Finite RZ
      (DivUniversalHighWindowMulSource (C := C) (pi := pi)
        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K) := by
  infer_instance

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
-- Reducing the dependent range and its base-changed map exceeds the default budget.
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
-- The range instance combines source finiteness with the dependent multiplication map.
/-- The finite multiplication span of a finite relation module is finite. -/
theorem finite_divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (n : Nat)
    (K : Submodule RZ
      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
    [Module.Finite RZ ↥K] :
    Module.Finite RZ
      ↥(divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (C := C) (pi := pi)
        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K) := by
  letI := finite_divUniversalHighWindowMulSource
    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K
  infer_instance

/-!
# Relation compatibility for high-window transitions

The recursive successor relation is the range of multiplication by a finite
basis of the multiplier window.  Consequently multiplication by every
base-field multiplier sends an arbitrary relation submodule into that successor:
expand the multiplier in the finite basis and use the corresponding coordinate
of `DivUniversalHighWindowMulSource`.

This is a genuine submodule inclusion over the nonreduced carve-chart ring.  It
does not use residue fibres or a saturation hypothesis.
-/

open Scheme Grassmannian

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
  Scheme.functionFieldOverModule

section HighWindowStage

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi] [IsDominant pi]

noncomputable local instance instOverCleftHighWindowStage :
    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
variable (g r1 r2 : Nat)
variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k ((windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    + (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)) ⊤))
variable (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)

local notation "RZ" => DivCarveChartRing k
  (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
  (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j

/-- The exponent of the `n`-th high window.  Thus index zero is `M` and index one is
the shifted carve window `M + s`. -/
noncomputable abbrev divUniversalHighWindowExponent (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  windowM_choice pi hpi g + n * windowS_choice pi hpi g

/-- The base-field section space at the `n`-th high window. -/
noncomputable abbrev divUniversalHighWindowSections (n : Nat) : Type u :=
  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
    (divUniversalHighWindowExponent (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n •
      fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)

/-- The scalar-extended ambient module at the `n`-th high window. -/
noncomputable abbrev divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (n : Nat) : Type u :=
  RZ ⊗[k] divUniversalHighWindowSections (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n

/-- Uniform high-window identification with relative theta sections. -/
noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowThetaEquiv (n : Nat) :
    divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n ≃ₗ[RZ]
      relThetaSections C RZ pi
        (divUniversalHighWindowExponent (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n) :=
  relThetaWindowEquiv C RZ pi
    (divUniversalHighWindowExponent (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n)
    (relThetaPairH1_windowM_add_mulS C pi hpi g n)

-- The dependent carve-chart tensor instance exceeds the default synthesis budget.
/-- Every high-window ambient is finite over the carve-chart ring. -/
theorem finite_divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (n : Nat) :
    Module.Finite RZ
      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n) := by
  infer_instance

set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
-- The dependent carve-chart tensor instance exceeds the default synthesis budget.
/-- Every high-window ambient is free over the carve-chart ring. -/
theorem free_divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (n : Nat) :
    Module.Free RZ
      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n) := by
  infer_instance

set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
-- Reusing the finite-dimensional base-change basis requires the larger chart budget.
/-- Every high-window ambient is projective over the carve-chart ring. -/
theorem projective_divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (n : Nat) :
    Module.Projective RZ
      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n) := by
  letI := free_divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n
  infer_instance

/-- Every high-window ambient is flat over the carve-chart ring. -/
theorem flat_divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (n : Nat) :
    Module.Flat RZ
      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n) := by
  letI := projective_divUniversalHighWindowAmbient
    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n
  exact Module.Flat.of_projective

/-- A projective quotient stage at the `n`-th high window.  This is deliberately the
existing Grassmannian datum: later saturation work only has to construct these points
and their transition compatibility. -/
abbrev DivUniversalHighWindowStage (n : Nat) : Type u :=
  Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k
    (divUniversalHighWindowSections (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n) g RZ

/-- The quotient module carried by a high-window stage. -/
abbrev divUniversalHighWindowQuotient (n : Nat)
    (x : DivUniversalHighWindowStage (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n) :
    Type u :=
  divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
    (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n ⧸
      x.toSubmodule

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeHighWindowRelativeKoszul
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeHighWindowTransitionRelationZero

/-!
# The relative Koszul boundary on the canonical relation tower

The transition-relation files prove that every multiplier-basis section sends
the canonical relation module at stage `n` into the canonical relation module
at stage `n + 1`, including the exceptional seed transition.  This file feeds
that preservation statement into the relative Koszul construction and records
the resulting canonical boundary and its vanishing under the next multiplication
map.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option quotPrecheck false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 8
set_option maxRecDepth 8000
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open Scheme Grassmannian

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
  Scheme.functionFieldOverModule
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

section HighWindowRelativeKoszulRelation

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi] [IsDominant pi]

noncomputable local instance instOverCleftHighWindowRelativeKoszulRelation :
    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
variable (g r1 r2 : Nat)
variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k ((windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    + (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)) ⊤))
variable (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)

local notation "RZ" => DivCarveChartRing k
  (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
  (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j
local notation "HS" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
  (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)
local notation "HI" => Fin (Module.finrank k HS)
local notation "K" n => divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)
  hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
-- The relation inclusion unfolds the dependent stage family and the seed map.
/-- The canonical relation tower satisfies the multiplier preservation
condition at every stage, including stage zero. -/
theorem divUniversalHighWindowRelation_mulPreserves (n : Nat) :
    DivUniversalHighWindowMulPreserves (C := C) (pi := pi)
      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n (K n) (K (n + 1)) := by
  intro t z
  have hz := map_divUniversalHighWindowBaseMultiplierTransition_relation_le
    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n
      ((Module.finBasis k HS) t)
      ⟨(K n).subtype z, z.property, rfl⟩
  change divUniversalHighWindowBaseMultiplierTransition (C := C) (pi := pi)
      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n ((Module.finBasis k HS) t)
      ((K n).subtype z) ∈ K (n + 1) at hz
  change divUniversalHighWindowBaseMultiplierTransition (C := C) (pi := pi)
      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n ((Module.finBasis k HS) t)
      ((K n).subtype z) ∈ K (n + 1)
  exact hz

/-- The basis-indexed multiplication step on the canonical relation tower. -/
noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowRelationBasisStep (n : Nat) (t : HI) :
    K n →ₗ[RZ] K (n + 1) :=
  divUniversalHighWindowBasisStep (C := C) (pi := pi)
    hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n (K n) (K (n + 1))
    (divUniversalHighWindowRelation_mulPreserves (C := C) (pi := pi)
      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n) t

/-- The canonical relative Koszul boundary
`(I × I → K_n) → (I → K_(n+1))`. -/
noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowRelationKoszulBoundary (n : Nat) :
    (HI × HI → K n) →ₗ[RZ] (HI → K (n + 1)) :=
  divUniversalHighWindowKoszulBoundary (C := C) (pi := pi)
    hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n (K n) (K (n + 1))
    (divUniversalHighWindowRelation_mulPreserves (C := C) (pi := pi)
      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
-- The next map and the relation boundary carry consecutive dependent stages.
/-- The next canonical multiplication map kills the canonical relation
Koszul boundary. -/
theorem divUniversalHighWindowMulMap_comp_relationKoszulBoundary_eq_zero
    (n : Nat) :
    (divUniversalHighWindowMulMap (C := C) (pi := pi)
        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1) (K (n + 1))).comp
      (divUniversalHighWindowRelationKoszulBoundary (C := C) (pi := pi)
        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n) = 0 := by
  exact divUniversalHighWindowMulMap_comp_koszulBoundary_eq_zero
    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n (K n) (K (n + 1))
      (divUniversalHighWindowRelation_mulPreserves (C := C) (pi := pi)
        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n)

end HighWindowRelativeKoszulRelation

end AlgebraicGeometry

/-!
# Residue-field normalization of the universal high-window ambients

At a field-valued point of a carve chart, cancelling the two-step scalar
extension identifies the relative high-window ambient with the scalar-extended
base-field window.  The `divFamPhi` dictionary then identifies that window with
the transported divisor-section space.

This file records the comparison uniformly at every exponent `M + n*S`.  It
also translates a successor window to the literal sum of the multiplier and
predecessor transported divisors.  The translation is valid after subtracting
an arbitrary divisor, and the resulting normalized successor read commutes
with multiplication.
-/

/-! ## Cancelling and reading a high-window ambient -/

/-- Cancel the two-step extension `K ⊗[RZ] (RZ ⊗[k] H_n)` at an
arbitrary high-window stage. -/
noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowAmbientCancelEquiv (n : Nat) :
    K ⊗[RZ] A n ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[k] H n :=
  TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k RZ K K (H n)

/-- Cancellation is natural for a base-changed map on the window leg. -/
theorem divUniversalHighWindowAmbientCancelEquiv_baseChange
    {H1 H2 : Type u} [AddCommGroup H1] [Module k H1]
    [AddCommGroup H2] [Module k H2] (f : H1 →ₗ[k] H2)
    (x : K ⊗[RZ] (RZ ⊗[k] H1)) :
    TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k RZ K K H2
        (LinearMap.baseChange K (LinearMap.baseChange RZ f) x) =
      LinearMap.baseChange K f
        (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k RZ K K H1 x) := by
  induction x with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | tmul a x =>
      induction x with
      | zero => simp
      | add x y hx hy => simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, hx, hy]
      | tmul r y =>
          simp only [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
            TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange_tmul]

/-- The `Phi` dictionary as an equivalence from the scalar-extended `n`-th
high window to the corresponding transported divisor-section space. -/
noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowPhiEquiv (n : Nat) :
    K ⊗[k] H n ≃ₗ[K]
      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K (windowTransportDivisor C K pi (e n)) ⊤) := by
  let f := (divFamPhi C K pi (e n)
      (relThetaPairH1_windowM_add_mulS C pi hpi g n)).codRestrict
      (Scheme.divisorSections K (windowTransportDivisor C K pi (e n)) ⊤)
      (fun x => divFamPhi_apply_mem C K pi (e n)
        (relThetaPairH1_windowM_add_mulS C pi hpi g n) x)
  refine LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    apply divFamPhi_injective C K pi (e n)
      (relThetaPairH1_windowM_add_mulS C pi hpi g n)
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hxy
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_divFamPhi_eq C K pi (e n)
      (relThetaPairH1_windowM_add_mulS C pi hpi g n) y.property
    exact ⟨x, Subtype.ext hx⟩

@[simp]
theorem divUniversalHighWindowPhiEquiv_apply (n : Nat) (x : K ⊗[k] H n) :
    (divUniversalHighWindowPhiEquiv (C := C) (pi := pi)
        hpi g K n x : (relCurve C K).functionField) =
      divFamPhi C K pi (e n)
        (relThetaPairH1_windowM_add_mulS C pi hpi g n) x :=
  rfl

/-- The normalized residue-field comparison for the complete ambient at every
high-window stage. -/
noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowAmbientFibreEquiv (n : Nat) :
    K ⊗[RZ] A n ≃ₗ[K]
      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K (windowTransportDivisor C K pi (e n)) ⊤) :=
  (divUniversalHighWindowAmbientCancelEquiv (C := C) (pi := pi)
      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K n).trans
    (divUniversalHighWindowPhiEquiv (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g K n)

set_option maxRecDepth 16000 in
@[simp]
theorem divUniversalHighWindowAmbientFibreEquiv_one_tmul (n : Nat) (x : A n) :
    (divUniversalHighWindowAmbientFibreEquiv (C := C) (pi := pi)
        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K n (1 ⊗ₜ[RZ] x) :
        (relCurve C K).functionField) =
      divFamPhi C K pi (e n)
        (relThetaPairH1_windowM_add_mulS C pi hpi g n)
        (windowCompare RZ K x) := by

/-! ## Coherence normalization with an arbitrary divisor -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 1200000 in
/-- Multiplication by the arbitrary-exponent coherence unit as an equivalence
of divisor-section spaces.  The auxiliary subtracted divisor is unrestricted. -/
noncomputable def windowAddCoherenceDivisorEquiv (p q : Nat)
    (D : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor) :
    ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi (p + q) - D) ⊤) ≃ₗ[K]
      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi p +
          windowTransportDivisor C K pi q - D) ⊤) := by
  let source := Scheme.divisorSections K
    (windowTransportDivisor C K pi (p + q) - D) ⊤
  let target := Scheme.divisorSections K
    (windowTransportDivisor C K pi p +
      windowTransportDivisor C K pi q - D) ⊤
  let mul := Scheme.mulLinear K
    ((windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K p q :
      (relCurve C K).functionFieldˣ) : (relCurve C K).functionField)
  let f := (mul.comp source.subtype).codRestrict target (fun x => by
    have hx : mul x ∈ Submodule.map mul source :=
      Submodule.mem_map_of_mem x.property
    rw [map_mulLinear_windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K p q D] at hx
    exact hx)
  refine LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply mul_left_cancel₀
      (Units.ne_zero (windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K p q))
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hxy
  · intro y
    have hy : (y : (relCurve C K).functionField) ∈ Submodule.map mul source := by
      rw [map_mulLinear_windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K p q D]
      exact y.property
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Subtype.ext hxy⟩

@[simp]
theorem windowAddCoherenceDivisorEquiv_apply (p q : Nat)
    (D : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor)
    (x : ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
      (windowTransportDivisor C K pi (p + q) - D) ⊤)) :
    (windowAddCoherenceDivisorEquiv (pi := pi) C K p q D x :
        (relCurve C K).functionField) =
      ((windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K p q :
        (relCurve C K).functionFieldˣ) : (relCurve C K).functionField) * x :=
  rfl

/-- The top-window specialization used to normalize a successor ambient. -/
noncomputable def windowAddCoherenceTopEquiv (p q : Nat) :
    ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi (p + q)) ⊤) ≃ₗ[K]
      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi p +
          windowTransportDivisor C K pi q) ⊤) := by
  simpa only [sub_zero] using
    windowAddCoherenceDivisorEquiv (pi := pi) C K p q 0

/-! ## The normalized successor multiplication square -/

/-- Reindex a transported successor section space to the sum exponent. -/
noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowSuccessorExponentFibreEquiv (n : Nat) :
    ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi (e (n + 1))) ⊤) ≃ₗ[K]
      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi
          (windowS_choice pi hpi g + e n)) ⊤) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (congrArg
    (fun m : Nat => Scheme.divisorSections K
      (windowTransportDivisor C K pi m) ⊤)
    (divUniversalHighWindowExponent_succ
      (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n).symm)

/-- The successor ambient read normalized to the literal divisor sum
`T(S) + T(M+nS)`. -/
noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowNormalizedSuccessorFibreEquiv (n : Nat) :
    K ⊗[RZ] A (n + 1) ≃ₗ[K]
      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi (windowS_choice pi hpi g) +
          windowTransportDivisor C K pi (e n)) ⊤) :=
  (divUniversalHighWindowAmbientFibreEquiv (C := C) (pi := pi)
      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K (n + 1)).trans
    ((divUniversalHighWindowSuccessorExponentFibreEquiv
      (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g K n).trans
      (windowAddCoherenceTopEquiv (pi := pi) C K
        (windowS_choice pi hpi g) (e n)))

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
set_option maxRecDepth 20000 in
/-- After cancelling the chart scalar extension and applying the coherence
normalization, successor multiplication is ordinary multiplication of the
multiplier and predecessor fibre reads. -/
theorem divUniversalHighWindowNormalizedSuccessorFibreEquiv_mul
    (n : Nat) (a : HS) (x : K ⊗[RZ] A n) :
    (divUniversalHighWindowNormalizedSuccessorFibreEquiv
        (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K n
        (LinearMap.baseChange K
          (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
            (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul
              (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n a)) x) :
        (relCurve C K).functionField) =
      (divUniversalMultiplierFibreEquiv (pi := pi) C hpi g K
          (1 ⊗ₜ[k] a) : (relCurve C K).functionField) *
        (divUniversalHighWindowAmbientFibreEquiv
          (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K n x :
          (relCurve C K).functionField) := by
  rw [divUniversalMultiplierFibreEquiv_apply]
  rw [divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul_eq, LinearMap.baseChange_comp,
    LinearMap.baseChange_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [divUniversalHighWindowAmbientCancelEquiv_baseChange]
  change ((windowAddCoherenceUnit (pi := pi) C K
      (windowS_choice pi hpi g) (e n) :
        (relCurve C K).functionFieldˣ) : (relCurve C K).functionField) *
      divFamPhi C K pi
        (windowS_choice pi hpi g + e n) _
        (LinearMap.baseChange K
          (thetaWindowMul (C := C) (pi := pi)
            (windowS_choice pi hpi g) (e n) a)
          (divUniversalHighWindowAmbientCancelEquiv
            (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K n x)) = _
  exact (divFamPhi_one_tmul_mul_general (pi := pi) C K
    (windowS_choice pi hpi g) (e n)
    (relThetaPairH1_windowS C hpi g)
    (relThetaPairH1_windowM_add_mulS C pi hpi g n)
    (by
      rw [divUniversalHighWindowExponent_succ
        (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n]
      exact relThetaPairH1_windowM_add_mulS C pi hpi g (n + 1))
    a
    (divUniversalHighWindowAmbientCancelEquiv
      (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K n x)).symm

end HighWindowFibreNormalization

     9	/-!
    10	# The finite Koszul boundary for a multiplication window
    11	
    12	Let `b : ι → U` be a finite multiplier basis.  If `L` is a preceding
    13	window and multiplication by `b i` sends `L` into the current window `T`,
    14	then a pair-indexed family `z : ι × ι → L` gives the usual row-minus-column
    15	relation
    16	
    17	`κ(z)_i = ∑ j, b_j z_(i,j) - b_j z_(j,i)`.
    18	
    19	The construction below is deliberately generic.  Its image is visibly killed
    20	by the finite component multiplication map; the converse inclusion is the
    21	actual high-window/Gotzmann syzygy theorem and is recorded at the end of this
    22	file as the remaining interface.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	
    27	universe u v
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	/-! ## A generic rows-minus-columns boundary -/
    34	
    35	variable {R L M N : Type u} [CommRing R]
    36	variable [AddCommGroup L] [Module R L]
    37	variable [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    38	variable [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    39	variable {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]
    40	
    41	/-- The alternating rows-minus-columns boundary attached to a family of
    42	`R`-linear maps `step i : L → M`.
    43	
    44	The two occurrences of `step` have the same multiplier index, while the
    45	outer index is the row of the resulting finite product.  This is the finite
    46	Koszul boundary used for multiplication syzygies.
    47	-/
    48	noncomputable def finiteKoszulBoundary (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M) :
    49	    (ι × ι → L) →ₗ[R] (ι → M) := by
    50	  classical
    51	  refine
    52	    { toFun := fun z i =>
    53	        ∑ j, (step j (z (i, j)) - step j (z (j, i)))
    54	      map_add' := ?_
    55	      map_smul' := ?_ }
    56	  · intro x y
    57	    funext i
    58	    change
    59	      (∑ j, (step j ((x + y) (i, j)) - step j ((x + y) (j, i)))) =
    60	        (∑ j, (step j (x (i, j)) - step j (x (j, i)))) +
    61	          ∑ j, (step j (y (i, j)) - step j (y (j, i)))
    62	    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    63	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    64	    intro j hj
    65	    simp only [Pi.add_apply, map_add]
    66	    abel
    67	  · intro r x
    68	    funext i
    69	    change
    70	      (∑ j, (step j ((r • x) (i, j)) - step j ((r • x) (j, i)))) =
    71	        r • (∑ j, (step j (x (i, j)) - step j (x (j, i))))
    72	    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    73	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    74	    intro j hj
    75	    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, map_smul, smul_sub]
    76	
    77	@[simp]
    78	theorem finiteKoszulBoundary_apply (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M)
    79	    (z : ι × ι → L) (i : ι) :
    80	    finiteKoszulBoundary step z i =
    81	      ∑ j, (step j (z (i, j)) - step j (z (j, i))) := rfl
    82	
    83	/-! ## Composition with a finite component sum -/
    84	
    85	/-- The component sum kills the rows-minus-columns boundary whenever the
    86	component maps commute pairwise.  This is the substantive finite-stage
    87	syzygy direction (`range ≤ kernel`).
    88	-/
    89	theorem finiteComponentSum_comp_finiteKoszulBoundary_eq_zero
    90	    (row : ι → M →ₗ[R] N) (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M)
    91	    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ι) (z : L),
    92	      row i (step j z) = row j (step i z)) :
    93	    (finiteComponentSum row).comp (finiteKoszulBoundary step) = 0 := by
    94	  classical
    95	  apply LinearMap.ext
    96	  intro z
    97	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, finiteComponentSum, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    98	    LinearMap.proj_apply, finiteKoszulBoundary_apply]
    99	  simp_rw [map_sum, map_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
   100	  change
   101	    (∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (i, j)))) -
   102	        ∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (j, i))) = 0
   103	  have hswap :
   104	      (∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (j, i)))) =
   105	        ∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (i, j))) := by
   106	    calc
   107	      (∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (j, i)))) =
   108	          ∑ i, ∑ j, row j (step i (z (j, i))) := by
   109	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   110	        intro i hi
   111	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   112	        intro j hj
   113	        exact hcomm i j (z (j, i))
   114	      _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, row j (step i (z (j, i))) := by
   115	        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   116	      _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (i, j))) := by
   117	        rfl
   118	  rw [hswap, sub_self]
   119	
   120	/-- Range form of the preceding composition identity. -/
   121	theorem range_finiteKoszulBoundary_le_ker_finiteComponentSum
   122	    (row : ι → M →ₗ[R] N) (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M)
   123	    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ι) (z : L),
   124	      row i (step j z) = row j (step i z)) :
   125	    LinearMap.range (finiteKoszulBoundary step) ≤
   126	      LinearMap.ker (finiteComponentSum row) := by
   127	  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
   128	  apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
   129	  have hz := LinearMap.congr_fun
   130	    (finiteComponentSum_comp_finiteKoszulBoundary_eq_zero row step hcomm) z
   131	  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] using hz
   132	
   133	/-! ## Scalar extension of the boundary -/
   134	
   135	section BaseChange
   136	
   137	variable {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
   138	
   139	/-- Scalar extension of the finite Koszul boundary commutes with the canonical
   140	finite-product tensor equivalences.  This is the bridge that identifies the
   141	base-changed relative boundary with the boundary formed directly in a fibre.
   142	-/
   143	theorem piRightHom_comp_baseChange_finiteKoszulBoundary
   144	    (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M) :
   145	    (TensorProduct.piRightHom R S S (fun _ : ι => M)).comp
   146	        (LinearMap.baseChange S (finiteKoszulBoundary step)) =
   147	      (finiteKoszulBoundary (fun i => LinearMap.baseChange S (step i))).comp
   148	        (TensorProduct.piRightHom R S S (fun _ : ι × ι => L)) := by
   149	  classical
   150	  apply LinearMap.ext
   151	  intro x
   152	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   153	  | zero => simp
   154	  | add x y hx hy =>
   155	      simpa only [map_add, LinearMap.comp_apply] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy
   156	  | tmul a z =>
   157	      ext i
   158	      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
   159	        TensorProduct.piRightHom_tmul, finiteKoszulBoundary_apply]
   160	      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
   161	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   162	      intro j hj
   163	      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub]
   164	
   165	/-- After transporting the target finite product, the range of the
   166	base-changed boundary is exactly the range of the fibrewise boundary. -/
   167	theorem range_piRightHom_comp_baseChange_finiteKoszulBoundary
   168	    (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M) :
   169	    LinearMap.range
   170	        ((TensorProduct.piRightHom R S S (fun _ : ι => M)).comp
   171	          (LinearMap.baseChange S (finiteKoszulBoundary step))) =
   172	      LinearMap.range
   173	        (finiteKoszulBoundary (fun i => LinearMap.baseChange S (step i))) := by
   174	  classical
   175	  rw [piRightHom_comp_baseChange_finiteKoszulBoundary]
   176	  apply le_antisymm
   177	  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
   178	    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _
   179	  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
   180	    let e := TensorProduct.piRight R S S (fun _ : ι × ι => L)
   181	    refine ⟨e.symm z, ?_⟩
   182	    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
   183	    have he : TensorProduct.piRightHom R S S (fun _ : ι × ι => L) (e.symm z) = z := by
   184	      change e (e.symm z) = z
   185	      exact e.apply_symm_apply z
   186	    rw [he]
   187	
   188	end BaseChange

   190	/-! ## A finite-dimensional equality criterion -/
   191	
   192	section Finrank
   193	
   194	variable {k₀ A V W : Type u} [Field k₀]
   195	variable [AddCommGroup A] [Module k₀ A]
   196	variable [AddCommGroup V] [Module k₀ V] [FiniteDimensional k₀ V]
   197	variable [AddCommGroup W] [Module k₀ W]
   198	
   199	/-- Over a field, the easy inclusion `range κ ≤ ker μ` is an equality as soon
   200	as the Koszul range has at least the dimension of the multiplication kernel.
   201	Thus the reverse syzygy theorem is reduced to its genuine Gotzmann rank input.
   202	-/
   203	theorem ker_finiteComponentSum_eq_range_finiteKoszulBoundary_of_finrank_le
   204	    (row : ι → V →ₗ[k₀] W) (step : ι → A →ₗ[k₀] V)
   205	    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ι) (z : A),
   206	      row i (step j z) = row j (step i z))
   207	    (hfin : Module.finrank k₀ (LinearMap.ker (finiteComponentSum row)) ≤
   208	      Module.finrank k₀ (LinearMap.range (finiteKoszulBoundary step))) :
   209	    LinearMap.ker (finiteComponentSum row) =
   210	      LinearMap.range (finiteKoszulBoundary step) := by
   211	  symm
   212	  exact Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le
   213	    (range_finiteKoszulBoundary_le_ker_finiteComponentSum row step hcomm) hfin
   214	
   215	end Finrank

   217	/-! ## The multiplication-window specialization -/
   218	
   219	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.functionFieldOverModule
   220	
   221	variable {K : Type u} [Field K]
   222	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
   223	variable {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]

   225	/-- Multiplication by the `i`-th multiplier basis vector, corestricted to the
   226	current window `T`.  The hypothesis records the only geometric input needed
   227	to form this map.
   228	-/
   229	noncomputable def Scheme.finiteMulStepTo
   230	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   231	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   232	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T)
   233	    (i : ι) : L →ₗ[K] T :=
   234	  ((Scheme.mulLinear K (b i : X.functionField)).comp L.subtype).codRestrict T

   243	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   244	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T)
   245	    (i : ι) (z : L) :
   246	    ((Scheme.finiteMulStepTo U L T b hmul i z : T) : X.functionField) =
   247	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) := by

   251	noncomputable def Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary
   252	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   253	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   254	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T) :
   255	    (ι × ι → L) →ₗ[K] (ι → T) :=
   256	  finiteKoszulBoundary (fun i => Scheme.finiteMulStepTo U L T b hmul i)

   259	theorem Scheme.finiteMulMap_comp_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_eq_zero
   260	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   261	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   262	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T) :
   263	    (Scheme.finiteMulMap U T b).comp

   268	    (b i : X.functionField) *
   269	          ((b j : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField)) =
   270	      (b j : X.functionField) *
   271	          ((b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField))

/-!
# Base change of a submodule with projective quotient

The inclusion of a submodule with projective quotient is split.  Consequently its
scalar extension is injective over an arbitrary algebra, without a flatness
hypothesis on that algebra.  This packages the resulting identification with
`Submodule.baseChange`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian

variable {R S M : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
variable [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- Scalar extension of a submodule with projective quotient, identified with the
submodule generated by its image after base change. -/
noncomputable def projectiveQuotientBaseChangeEquiv (N : Submodule R M)
    [Module.Projective R (M ⧸ N)] :
    S ⊗[R] N ≃ₗ[S] N.baseChange S := by
  have hsplit : quotRetract N ∘ₗ N.subtype = LinearMap.id :=
    LinearMap.ext fun x => quotRetract_apply_of_mem N x.2
  have hinj : Function.Injective (LinearMap.baseChange S N.subtype) := by
    have hleft : LinearMap.baseChange S (quotRetract N) ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.baseChange S N.subtype = LinearMap.id := by
      rw [← LinearMap.baseChange_comp, hsplit, LinearMap.baseChange_id]
    exact Function.LeftInverse.injective
      (g := LinearMap.baseChange S (quotRetract N))
      fun x => by rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, hleft, LinearMap.id_apply]
  refine LinearEquiv.ofBijective (N.toBaseChange S) ⟨?_, N.toBaseChange_surjective S⟩
  intro x y hxy
  apply hinj
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hxy

@[simp]
theorem projectiveQuotientBaseChangeEquiv_apply (N : Submodule R M)
    [Module.Projective R (M ⧸ N)] (x : S ⊗[R] N) :
    projectiveQuotientBaseChangeEquiv (S := S) N x = N.toBaseChange S x :=
  rfl

section Window

variable {k K H : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing K]
variable [Algebra k R] [Algebra k K] [Algebra R K] [IsScalarTower k R K]
variable [AddCommGroup H] [Module k H]

/-- A projective-quotient window after scalar extension, identified with the kernel
of its base-changed quotient map in the cancelled tensor-product ambient. -/
noncomputable def projectiveQuotientWindowFibreEquiv
    (N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H))
    [Module.Projective R (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N)] :
    K ⊗[R] N ≃ₗ[K]
      LinearMap.ker (Module.Grassmannian.baseChangeMkQ K N) :=
  (projectiveQuotientBaseChangeEquiv (S := K) N).trans
    ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective
      (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R K K H).toLinearMap
      (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R K K H).injective
      (N.baseChange K)).trans
        (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _
          (ker_baseChangeMkQ_eq_map_baseChange K N).symm))

end Window

end AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeHighWindowSyzygy

/-!
# Conjugacy transfer for a fibre syzygy presentation

This file is deliberately independent of the high-window geometry.  It packages the
linear algebra used after a fibre model has been constructed: kernel containment for
the field presentation transfers through three base-change equivalences to the
corresponding relative presentation.  The final corollary feeds that containment into
the `liftQ` injectivity criterion from `DivSchemeHighWindowSyzygy`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

section Conjugacy

variable {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
variable {P M N : Type u}
variable [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P]
variable [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
variable [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
variable {P' M' N' : Type u}
variable [AddCommGroup P'] [Module S P']
variable [AddCommGroup M'] [Module S M']
variable [AddCommGroup N'] [Module S N']

/-- Kernel containment transfers through equivalences conjugating a pair of maps
and their base changes.  The equivalences need not arise from tensor products;
the statement only uses their bijectivity and the two displayed naturality laws.

`hf` conjugates `baseChange S f` to `f'`, while `hd` conjugates `baseChange S d`
to `d'`.  Thus a witness in the fibre range can be pulled back through the
source equivalence and gives a witness in the relative base-change range.
-/
theorem ker_baseChange_le_range_baseChange_of_conjugate
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (d : P →ₗ[R] M)
    (f' : M' →ₗ[S] N') (d' : P' →ₗ[S] M')
    (eM : (S ⊗[R] M) ≃ₗ[S] M')
    (eN : (S ⊗[R] N) ≃ₗ[S] N')
    (eP : (S ⊗[R] P) ≃ₗ[S] P')
    (hf : ∀ x : S ⊗[R] M,
      eN (LinearMap.baseChange S f x) = f' (eM x))
    (hd : ∀ y : S ⊗[R] P,
      eM (LinearMap.baseChange S d y) = d' (eP y))
    (hker : LinearMap.ker f' ≤ LinearMap.range d') :
    LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.baseChange S f) ≤
      LinearMap.range (LinearMap.baseChange S d) := by
  intro x hx
  have hfx' : f' (eM x) = 0 := by
    rw [← hf x, LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hker (LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hfx')
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := eP.surjective z
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  apply eM.injective
  rw [hd y, hz, eP.apply_symm_apply]

/-- The same transfer followed by the relative `liftQ` criterion.  This is the
generic shape consumed by the high-window relation induction: an independent
fibre boundary presentation proves injectivity of the base-changed
injectivization, without assuming flatness of its target quotient.
-/
theorem liftQ_baseChange_injective_of_conjugate_boundary
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (d : P →ₗ[R] M) (hfd : f.comp d = 0)
    (f' : M' →ₗ[S] N') (d' : P' →ₗ[S] M')
    (eM : (S ⊗[R] M) ≃ₗ[S] M')
    (eN : (S ⊗[R] N) ≃ₗ[S] N')
    (eP : (S ⊗[R] P) ≃ₗ[S] P')
    (hf : ∀ x : S ⊗[R] M,
      eN (LinearMap.baseChange S f x) = f' (eM x))
    (hd : ∀ y : S ⊗[R] P,
      eM (LinearMap.baseChange S d y) = d' (eP y))
    (hker : LinearMap.ker f' ≤ LinearMap.range d') :
    Function.Injective
      (LinearMap.baseChange S ((LinearMap.ker f).liftQ f le_rfl)) := by
  exact liftQ_baseChange_injective_of_boundary f d hfd S
    (ker_baseChange_le_range_baseChange_of_conjugate
      f d f' d' eM eN eP hf hd hker)

end Conjugacy

end AlgebraicGeometry
